mapper.sql: id, user_id, user_name, user_account, exam_paper_id, exam_title, score, total_score, duration, actual_duration, status, start_time, end_time, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO et_user_exam_history (user_id, user_name, user_account, exam_paper_id, exam_title, score, total_score, duration, actual_duration, status, start_time, end_time, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{userName}, #{userAccount}, #{examPaperId}, #{examTitle}, #{score}, #{totalScore}, #{duration}, #{actualDuration}, #{status}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE et_user_exam_history SET user_name = #{userName}, user_account = #{userAccount}, exam_title = #{examTitle}, score = #{score}, total_score = #{totalScore}, duration = #{duration}, actual_duration = #{actualDuration}, status = #{status}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM et_user_exam_history WHERE exam_paper_id = #{examPaperId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM et_user_exam_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM et_user_exam_history WHERE exam_paper_id = #{examPaperId} AND status = 'completed' ORDER BY score DESC, end_time ASC
SELECT FROM et_user_exam_history WHERE exam_paper_id = #{examPaperId} AND status = 'absent' ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM et_user_exam_history WHERE exam_paper_id = #{examPaperId} AND status = 'completed'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM et_user_exam_history WHERE exam_paper_id = #{examPaperId} AND status = 'absent'
SELECT COALESCE(AVG(score), 0) FROM et_user_exam_history WHERE exam_paper_id = #{examPaperId} AND status = 'completed'
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(score), 0) FROM et_user_exam_history WHERE exam_paper_id = #{examPaperId} AND status = 'completed'
SELECT COALESCE(MIN(score), 0) FROM et_user_exam_history WHERE exam_paper_id = #{examPaperId} AND status = 'completed'

SELECT CASE WHEN total.total_count = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(passed.pass_count * 100.0 / total.total_count, 2) END as pass_rate FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) as total_count FROM et_user_exam_history WHERE exam_paper_id = #{examPaperId} AND status = 'completed' ) total, ( SELECT COUNT(*) as pass_count FROM et_user_exam_history WHERE exam_paper_id = #{examPaperId} AND status = 'completed' AND score >= #{passScore} ) passed
SELECT FROM et_user_exam_history WHERE exam_paper_id = #{examPaperId} AND status = 'completed' ORDER BY score DESC, end_time ASC
SELECT FROM et_user_exam_history WHERE exam_paper_id = #{examPaperId} AND status = 'completed' ORDER BY actual_duration ASC
SELECT FROM et_user_exam_history WHERE exam_paper_id = #{examPaperId} ORDER BY score DESC, user_name ASC
